Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Just a quick note,

Towards the preservation of my employment, I have
voluntarily taken my VtES page off-line.

I am in the process of setting it back up on
the HomeFree site (a wonderful idea, that),
but HomeFree doesn't offer CGI-script access.

If anyone would like to host my rulings/card list/
house rules search engine, let me know.

It's been fun.
Hope to be back soon.
--
